name: Marinated Vegetable Salad
description: A colorful salad of marinated vegetables including cauliflower, broccoli, carrots, and radishes, dressed with Italian dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and clean all the vegetables, then drain well.
Break cauliflower and broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
Trim radishes and carrots; leave whole or cut into bite-sized pieces if large.
Cut celery into 3-inch pieces and slice cucumber into 1/2-inch slices.
Leave cherry tomatoes whole and place all vegetables in a large bowl.
Pour Italian dressing over the vegetables and let set for a few hours.
Serve as finger food or as a salad.

keywords: marinated vegetables, vegetable salad, Italian dressing

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: Veggie Basic Soup
_similar.description: A hearty vegetable soup made with a variety of vegetables and flavorful broth.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Cook onions, carrots, and celery until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tomatoes, beef broth, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and flavors are well blended.

_similar.keywords: vegetable soup, beef broth, savory soup

_similar.name: Fresh Broccoli Mandarin Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring fresh broccoli, mandarin oranges, mushrooms, and a rich, creamy dressing with a hint of mustard.
recipeIngredient: 1 egg plus 1 egg yolk, slightly beaten
½ medium red onion, sliced into rings

recipeInstructions.text: In the top of a double boiler, whisk together the egg, egg yolk, sugar, cornstarch, and mustard.
Slowly whisk in the vinegar and water mixture, then cook over hot water, stirring constantly, until the dressing thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in the softened butter and mayonnaise. Chill the dressing.
Just before serving, combine the crumbled bacon, mushrooms, almonds, mandarin oranges, red onion, and broccoli in a large salad bowl.
Add the chilled dressing and toss to coat the salad ingredients evenly.
Refrigerate any leftovers.

_similar.keywords: broccoli mandarin salad, creamy dressing, fresh salad

_similar.name: Onion Salad
_similar.description: A simple onion salad marinated in a sweet and tangy dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Marinate the thinly sliced onions with salt, sugar, water, and vinegar overnight.
Drain the marinade well in the morning.
Add mayonnaise (or salad dressing) and celery seed to the drained onions.
Chill until ready to serve.

_similar.keywords: onion salad, marinated onions, sweet and tangy salad

_similar.name: Pasta Salad
_similar.description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

_similar.keywords: pasta salad, feta cheese, herb dressing, vegetable salad
